lines: Night one. The guns of the ridge never stopped.
five men of the Hegemony did not see the morning.
Bram Yoollyfox. Pavel Zulfi. Nils Wolfmananton. Oskar Brunoescobar. And one more. The Concord buried one too.
But no name dies out here.
That same night, Dorian Yoollyfox reports for duty. The next of the family picks up the rifle.
Every family keeps a tree. Every fall is written in it. Open your soldier's card, and read your house.
